integrity: The unrestricted proof uses a rim-covering criterion and established matroid shellability. Exact finite checker results are auxiliary, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to geometric fixed spaces of cyclic rotation subgroups, not orbit spaces or reflection-containing subgroups; no new ordinary wheel homology rank is claimed. Literature comparisons cannot guarantee priority over inaccessible or unindexed work.
title: Cyclic fixed loci of wheel-forest complexes are smaller wheel-forest complexes
